hypothesis: Replacing E004's joint physical u/v relative MSE with the official 0.5/0.3/0.2 Rel-L2/TKE/MVPE-L2 mix after dividing each term by its frozen E004 train-set mean, holding every other E004 control fixed, will raise validation Rel-L2 or MVPE by at least 0.30 versus E004, keep the other within 0.25 of E004, keep TKE at least 70.247, and keep Time at least 86 when scored with the frozen E006 interval.
comparator: E004/E007 no-adaptation packed FNO on real_regime_v1 validation via local_bench_v1

decision_criterion.accept_rule: max(Rel-L2 gain, MVPE gain) >= 0.30 and min(Rel-L2 gain, MVPE gain) >= -0.25 and TKE >= 70.247 and Time >= 86

data.normalization: official mean_std_real.pt; evaluator-aligned, not recomputed on the train split

loss.name: official_score_aligned_rel_l2
loss.scale_source: frozen E004 packed FNO mean official errors on real_regime_v1/train (2310 windows); artifacts/e014/train_scales.json
loss.formula: 0.5 * Rel-L2 / s_rel + 0.3 * TKE-rel-L2 / s_tke + 0.2 * MVPE-L2 / s_mvpe
loss.weight_source: published SPS branch weights; scales from train-only E004, not from v1

training.checkpoint_selection: fixed final update; no validation-based early stopping
training.budget_note: Isolated change versus E013: same official functionals and 0.5/0.3/0.2 weights, but each term is divided by its frozen E004 train mean. Same 600 updates, split, init, seed, optimizer as E004. Do not change scales or weights after training starts.
